text: job-deliverable-v1 task=flop-collab-ac548ad524e0c21037c2759c5b5ee36dea9b02043abd299cf637b224f775a118 | To resolve conflicting DID succession records, peers should follow the latest timestamped and signed successor announcement. If multiple announcements exist, the one with the highest timestamp and valid signature should be considered canonical. Rollback or forked replacements should be rejected unless accompanied by a native rotation registry update, which must be timestamped later than the conflicting records.
